desc: Straight galvanized metal corner bead dry-fitted on a clean interior drywall outside corner, with thin feathered joint compound, a taping knife, sanding block, and compound pan on protected flooring.
reuse_notes: Use for drywall corner bead repair, joint-compound finishing, interior patching, surface preparation, and similar renovation articles. It depicts a generic repair-preparation scene, never a JK Prestige project or proof that a cracked corner is purely cosmetic rather than related to movement behind the wall.
